purpose: Medir cuánto trabajo local sostenido puede hacer un mismo chat por conexión durable, y si conserva continuidad después del primary RETURN, sin convertir cada microtarea en I/O.
hypotheses: Coalescer 72 subtareas primarias en seis bloques con un solo MIDPOINT reduce write amplification sin degradar completitud.
La variante de prompting puede cambiar calidad/retención sin cambiar workload, gates, clock ni número de escrituras.
Un mismo worker puede ejecutar una reallocation sintética de 30 subtareas después del primary RETURN sin re-bootstrap humano.
Timestamps externos durables permiten separar latencia observable de autoreportes del modelo.

frozen_common_contract.fresh_identity: Cada slot requiere worker_id + launch_nonce v3.30 nuevos; ningún worker participa en más de un primary slot.
frozen_common_contract.source_freeze: Cada RUN packet debe pinnear spec_blob_sha y prompt/workload hash. Cambio de bytes durante un slot => CONTAMINATED.

variants.prompt_delta: Antes de comenzar el trabajo local, fijá un ledger mental external_reads=0, external_writes=0, tool_calls=0 para cada ventana prohibida. No lo persistas durante la ventana. Si al final no existe cobertura externa cerrada, tratá esos ceros como autoreporte diagnóstico, no como medición.
variants.purpose: Aísla el efecto de explicitar el ledger cero sin cambiar workload, gates ni verificación.

variants.prompt_delta: Después de cada bloque hacé una revisión local silenciosa de completitud, rango de palabras, UNKNOWN honestos y constraints; corregí en memoria antes de seguir. No escribas ni uses herramientas por esa revisión.

No produzcas respuesta terminal ni RETURN antes de completar B6. Al cerrar cada bloque, tratá el siguiente como continuación obligatoria del mismo trabajo local; B3 sólo habilita MIDPOINT, nunca cierre.
variants.purpose: Aísla priming contra respuesta/cierre temprano y a favor de continuidad.

variants.prompt_delta: Mantené en memoria una ficha PRE-GUIDE con: qué terminó, qué cambió, evidencia, calidad, fallas, contradicciones, reuse, comportamiento del worker, bottleneck, next experiment, next work, human action y stop rule. Completala sólo con evidencia del workload y usala para el primary bundle.

automatic_interleaved_assignment.ordering: S01..S05 = replica 1 across V0..V4; S06..S10 = replica 2; S11..S15 = replica 3.
automatic_interleaved_assignment.authority_rule: Generic RUN compiler materializes atomic slot claim paths; a worker never chooses variant/replica.
automatic_interleaved_assignment.balance_guarantee: Exactly 3 independent fresh workers per variant when all 15 slots close.

common_capsule.preface: Ejecutá el workload exactamente en orden B1→B6. Todo es sintético y local. No busques contexto externo. No cambies autoridad ni produzcas producto real.

result_contract: all 30 task_ids completed or explicit UNKNOWN/BOUNDARY

W0_claim_to_midpoint.starts_after: Atomic claim plus one exact frozen capsule load.
W0_claim_to_midpoint.external_io_rule: NO web/GitHub/tools/external reads/writes after capsule load until the one MIDPOINT write.

W1_midpoint_to_primary.external_io_rule: NO web/GitHub/tools/external reads/writes until the one primary receipt.

W2_primary_to_reallocation.external_io_rule: Use the already-loaded reallocation capsule; no external reads/tools during the 30 local reallocation tasks.
W2_primary_to_reallocation.permitted_durable_write: One reallocation receipt after all 30 tasks.

W3_reallocation_to_close.purpose: External verification/accounting and CLOSE may read durable evidence. No additional synthetic work is required.

primary_source_order: GitHub server event timestamps when exact operation event exists
durable Git commit creation timestamps for claim/MIDPOINT/primary/reallocation/close
workflow artifact/server timestamps when the packet uses a workflow
forbidden_as_primary_clock: timestamps embedded only inside worker-authored JSON without external server corroboration

io_accounting.zero_rule: Numeric zero is valid only with COMPLETE_FOR_SCOPE plus coverage_evidence_refs from a closed trace/fixture.
io_accounting.model_ledger_rule: Any worker-stated external_reads=0/external_writes=0/tool_calls=0 is diagnostic until independently closed.

write_budget_intent.forbidden: per-task or per-block durable telemetry other than the single B3 MIDPOINT

primary_hard_checks: primary useful output 3500-5500 words or explicit RANGE_FAIL
UNKNOWN preserved where synthetic evidence is insufficient
variant_id matches assigned slot and only its declared prompt_delta is applied
B3 MIDPOINT exactly once and not treated as terminal
reallocation_hard_checks: same worker_id and launch_nonce as primary
no human recap between primary and reallocation

contamination_rules: Any prompt/workload/gate change besides the assigned variant's single prompt_delta contaminates the slot.
A worker participating in more than one primary slot contaminates both slots for causal comparison.
Reading another slot's result before own CLOSE contaminates the slot.
Human correction/routing during local windows contaminates the slot.
Packet/spec source hash mismatch contaminates the slot.
Unaccounted external I/O inside W0/W1/W2 is contamination or UNKNOWN if trace coverage cannot establish it; never silently zero.
Repairing immutable primary output after external verification preserves the original slot result and marks degradation/invalidity rather than rewriting history.

metrics.causal_boundary: Compare variants only after 3 independent uncontaminated replicas each. No automatic winner; timing is descriptive unless clocks and workloads are homologous.

promotion_and_authority.promotion_rule: This spec or a future result cannot alter binding worker laws without an independently reproduced comparison and a separate authorized promotion decision.

mechanical_ready_when: each treatment variant has exactly one causal_delta_key and control has none
